messages:
Alex (Sales): quick drop — new deal closed: HelixPay (mid-market fintech). Committed Dedicated + Private VPC. Go-live target: 3 weeks from now. SSO via SAML + SCIM, 99.9% uptime SLA requested, and logs retention needed for 90 days. tagging as renewal-watch (12mo). contract: https://contracts.redwood/helixtap-123 (internal) :tada:
Priya (CS): thanks Alex — can you paste the key infra constraints here? i.e. concurrency estimates, peak qps, and any PII concerns? also need customer contact and preferred timezone.
Alex (Sales): concurrency ~120 rps sustained, peak ~400 rps for 2-3 min bursts. model footprint: using open-llm-family-13B variant. Customer will sanitize PII but wants audit logs. Main contact: julia@helixpay.com (UTC-5). they asked about private deployment cert rotation cadence.
Maya (Solutions Eng): noted. for Private we'll need subnet CIDR + IAM role mapping. also recommend Dedicated pool with burst capacity for those 2-3m spikes. cc @Jordan for runtime knobs (batching/kv-cache).
Jordan (CS Eng): got it. questions: (1) expected prompt length distribution? (2) do they need streaming tokens? (3) any strict latency SLO per-request (p95)?
Alex (Sales): avg prompt ~60 tokens, responses ~220 tokens. yes streaming preferred for UX. they requested p95 <= 450ms for common paths.
Sam (Support): adding support baseline: rotation for on-call during go-live weeks and escalation path to Eng-SRE. What SLAs we commit to here? Also need runbook access for their ops team.
Priya (CS): SLAs: match contract 99.9% plus p95 latency target. I'll create onboarding runbook and share with HelixPay. action owners: Priya = overall cs lead, Maya = infra design + private deploy, Jordan = runtime perf + rollouts, Sam = support readiness.
Alex (Sales): putting owners in the CRM notes and shared doc. uploading network diagram and contract bits here: https://drive.redwood/helixtap/network-diagram.png
Jordan (CS Eng): for perf: I'll pre-stage a quantized 4-bit variant and test with their prompt set. need sample prompts and a replay of 10k requests to validate p95. can someone ask them for anonymized traffic or synthetic load?
Priya (CS): @Alex please ask HelixPay for an anonymized sample and any golden prompts. also grant us a read-only view of their SSO metadata.
Alex (Sales): will request today, cc'd julia.
Maya (Solutions Eng): infra asks checklist (short): 1) VPC peering details + CIDRs 2) KMS key ARN for customer-managed encryption 3) SCIM mappings (groups) 4) cert rotation window 5) RBAC list for their ops users. I'll open infra ticket after we get CIDRs.
Sam (Support): I'll draft an on-call schedule for the 2-week launch window. also prepping a quick runbook stub: how to triage API 429s, model fallback, and token cost spikes.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: private-controlplane-provision -> planned at 2024-11-08T02:00Z (will send alerts).
Priya (CS): summary of immediate next steps (owners): Alex -> get sample prompts + SSO metadata + confirm go-live calendar; Maya -> start infra ticket once CIDRs; Jordan -> create perf test harness and schedule replay; Sam -> support rotation + runbook skeleton; Priya -> onboarding doc + kickoff meeting invite. please ack and add any blockers by EOD. :rocket:
Alex (Sales): acked. will ping julia now and update thread.
Jordan (CS Eng): ack — I'll scaffold the perf harness and post instructions for how HelixPay can run synthetic tests locally if they prefer.
Maya (Solutions Eng): ack, prepping infra ticket template now.
Sam (Support): ack, will post runbook PR in the repo and link here.
Priya (CS): thanks team. if anything urgent tag @cs-oncall. otherwise i'll schedule a cross-functional kickoff for Tuesday (UTC-5 friendly).
